title: Fellow Mallworlders... Have you recently been attacked, or hunted?
content: In the past week, a very normal mallworld experience has become often a random cat and mouse 70s horror slasher. A weird guy with a cat pops up and makes allegations of past transgressions that he swears i made (but i didnt), , girlfriends I had in high-school are teaming up to seek decades old revenge, ai gone haywire turning the escalators into meat grinders. I am not, I swear it, being facetious. I getvif i was watching spooky movies around Halloween, these ideas would of course seep in to the subconscious. The thing is, I've been too busy this October to even watch many horror flicks. Like 3. I'd usually be up to 20, like 1 a day. And I don't have scary mallworlds. Ever. So it isn't my spooky movie intake. Could it be, with all the spooky media being consumed all around,.... it's the general fear of horror movies and shows, releases it into the mallworld somehow? Interested to know what you think. M.
